scope: Evening short-wavelength/melanopic-light filtering eyewear; excludes red-light therapy and photobiomodulation.

landingDecisions.evidencePosture: mechanistically plausible; direct glasses evidence small and mixed; objective actigraphy synthesis null/non-significant; source pages now resolve the pass-2 inventory-only records used by protocol claims
landingDecisions.rightsPosture: only clearly open-access PDFs are marked redistributable; permission-required and rights-unreviewed artifacts remain non-redistributable placeholders
